photos.name: both-loaves-cooling-rack
photos.summary: Both loaves cooling on a wire rack, foreground boule showing heavy blistering and a cross score with good ear development.

photos.name: crumb-shot-cross-section
photos.summary: Cross-section of the loaf on a cutting board, showing an open, airy crumb with good hole structure throughout.

photos.name: dough-after-bulk-ferment
photos.summary: Dough after bulk fermentation in a clear glass bowl, smooth and domed with visible surface tension.

photos.name: dough-in-banneton-no-linen
photos.summary: Shaped dough proofing in a round banneton without the linen liner, testing direct contact with the rattan spiral pattern.

photos.name: finished-boule-blistered-crust-vsco
photos.summary: Finished boule cooling on a wire rack, showing dramatic blistering across the entire crust and a deep cross score with dark caramelized ears.

photos.name: loaf-mid-bake-banneton-pattern
photos.summary: Loaf mid-bake on the oven rack on parchment, visible banneton ring pattern on the crust with the cross score opening up.

photos.name: loaf-mid-bake-challenger
photos.summary: Loaf mid-bake inside the Challenger bread pan on parchment, early oven spring visible with blisters already forming on the pale crust.

photos.name: two-pre-shaped-rounds
photos.summary: Two pre-shaped rounds resting on a silicone baking mat, smooth and taut after the bench rest before final shaping.
